motions.item_title: Approve the minutes of March 24, 2026, Planning Commission meeting with the correction of Commi…
motions.motion: Commissioner Free moved to approve the minutes of March 24, 2026, Planning Commission meeting with the correction of Commissioner Hess leading the Pledge of Allegiance. Commissioner Lane seconded the motion.
motions.headline: March minutes fixed and approved
motions.summary: The commission approved its March 24, 2026 minutes after correcting the record to show Commissioner Hess led the Pledge of Allegiance.
motions.impact: Housekeeping that makes the last meeting's record official. Nobody outside the meeting room feels it.

motions.item_title: Table Item 6.A., Preliminary Plat-Spring Run Plaza, until the next Planning Commission meeting…
motions.motion: Commissioner Strong moved to table Item 6.A., Preliminary Plat-Spring Run Plaza, until the next Planning Commission meeting on April 28, 2026. Commissioner Allen seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Spring Run Plaza plat held to April 28
motions.summary: A decision on the preliminary plat for Spring Run Plaza was pushed to the commission's April 28, 2026 meeting.
motions.impact: Two more weeks before anything is decided about this project. If you want to weigh in, the item comes back at the end of the month.

motions.item_title: Recommend approval to the City Council of Item 6.B., Brandon Park Rezone. Commissioner Lane sec…
motions.motion: Commissioner Hess moved to recommend approval to the City Council of Item 6.B., Brandon Park Rezone. Commissioner Lane seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Brandon Park zoning change moves to council
motions.summary: The commission recommended the council approve a zoning change for Brandon Park.
motions.impact: A zoning change decides what can be built on the land, so neighbors have reason to follow it. Acreage and the new zone are not in the record here, and the council still has to vote.

motions.item_title: Recommend approval to the City Council of Item 6.C., EMMC 17.72, Drive-through and structured p…
motions.motion: Commissioner Allen moved to recommend approval to the City Council of Item 6.C., EMMC 17.72, Drive-through and structured parking text Code Amendment as presented. Commissioner Strong seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Drive-through and parking garage rules advance
motions.summary: City code covering drive-throughs and structured parking would be rewritten under an amendment the commission sent to the council unchanged.
motions.impact: Anyone designing a drive-through restaurant or a parking structure would build to the new standards. The council has not voted, and the motion does not describe what the standards say.

motions.item_title: Recommend approval to the City Council of Item 6.D., EMMC 17.55 and 17.60, Landscape and buffer…
motions.motion: Commissioner Hess moved to recommend approval to the City Council of Item 6.D., EMMC 17.55 and 17.60, Landscape and buffering text Code Amendment, with the language under 17. 60.110C be revised or amended as such: Provide perennial and evergreen plant material, including trees, shrubs, ornamental grasses or perennials, in a configuration at the time of planting that will provide a minimum 3.5- foot tall, continuous vegetative barrier to screen headlights. . Commissioner Allen seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Taller screening plants along parking lots
motions.summary: The commission backed new landscape and buffering rules, rewriting one line to require a continuous 3.5-foot-tall wall of plants to block headlights.
motions.impact: Developers planting new parking areas would have to put in trees, shrubs or grasses tall enough at planting to hide headlights from neighbors. The council decides whether it becomes law.

motions.item_title: Recommend approval to the City Council of Item 6.E., Flagship Development Agreement. Commission…
motions.motion: Commissioner Strong moved to recommend approval to the City Council of Item 6.E., Flagship Development Agreement. Commissioner Lane seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Flagship development agreement sent to council
motions.summary: The commission asked the City Council to approve a development agreement for Flagship, the terms of which the motion does not spell out.
motions.impact: Nothing is settled yet: the council takes the final vote. The record here gives no location, acreage or unit count, so what it would build is not something this motion tells you.

ordinances.line_text: for clear, enforceable language in the ordinance.
